"""Supplemental native-state fault probe, run sequentially after make test."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from test_intake_email import IntakeEmailTests
from acquisition.audiences import contact_snapshot_from
from acquisition.contracts import Conflict,canonical,digest
results=[]
for kind in ('contact_pause','account_stop','email_objection','foreign_stop'):
    case=IntakeEmailTests()
    try:
        case.setUp();case.prepare();a=case.approve();case.export(approval=a)
        view=case.view();subject=view['subject']['id'];snapshot=contact_snapshot_from(view['batch']['contacts'])
        with case.app.store.database.transaction() as db:
            if kind=='email_objection':
                payload={'kind':'contact-objection/v1','contact_id':snapshot.contacts[0].ref.id,'channel':'email','purpose':'acquisition','reason':'Probe current recipient objection.','organization':'one','recorded_at':case.now}
                db.execute('INSERT INTO contact_objections VALUES(?,?,?)',('one','objection_'+digest(payload),canonical(payload)))
            else:
                scope='account' if kind=='account_stop' else 'contact'
                subject_id=snapshot.accounts[0].ref.id if scope=='account' else snapshot.contacts[0].ref.id
                org='foreign' if kind=='foreign_stop' else 'one'
                payload={'probe':kind}
                db.execute('INSERT INTO engagement_stops VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(org,'engagement_stop_'+digest(payload),None,scope,subject_id,'pause' if kind=='contact_pause' else 'stop',canonical(payload)))
        current=case.view();blocked=False
        try:case.app.email_reviews.download('one','operator','export',subject)
        except Conflict:blocked=True
        expected=kind!='foreign_stop'
        assert blocked==expected,(kind,blocked)
        assert current['approval_valid']==(not expected),kind
        if expected:assert not current['review_ready'],kind
        results.append({'case':kind,'download_blocked':blocked,'current_approval_valid':current['approval_valid'],'passed':True})
    finally:case.doCleanups()
Path('/private/tmp/iwoca-email-stop-results.json').write_text(json.dumps({'cases':results,'mechanism':'scoped native-row fault injection, not a contact administration workflow'},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(results))
